search_width.basis: The gated rule never reads entry_bps (it decides on the EWMA of funding, the cost of capital and the basis budget), so carry_rule_sweep@59feb30d2328's 1,440 cells are 60 distinct rules printed 24 times. carry_rule_sweep@d7d7d4141a05 (540 cells) and carry_walkforward@69b08ab2ab84 range over the same axes (hold_days x negative_exit_prints x ewma_alpha): 540 distinct rules, which the walk-forward scored in 38 refit windows, so its 20,520 is 540 x 38 SCORINGS, not 20,520 rules. Source: the 'THE DEFECT THIS ALSO FIXES' section of tools/carry_walkforward.py.

breakdown.overlap_between_them: not established; counted separately, which can only over-count

search_width.do_not_use: The raw sum of the three entries' printed counts (about 22,500) double counts and is not a search width: it must not be quoted as one.
search_width.still_a_floor: Abandoned variants left no artefact, so this is still a floor on the number of distinct things tried. The rules are correlated, so the effective independent N is lower than the count; nothing here estimates that, and the correction should be read at the harsh end of the range.

seed_is_a_floor_not_a_census: Abandoned parameter grids, one-off variants and re-runs over different windows are trials too and are NOT counted here. The true search width is larger than this count, so the true multiple-testing correction is harsher than what this registry currently supports.

The rule CarryEngine runs from PR #124 (3aadf2f): carry_costs.entry_gate = evaluate_entry (carry_cost_gates_v1) and THEN hold_clears_round_trip: the smoothed funding must earn back the round trip (plus borrow) within DEMONSTRATED_HOLD_DAYS (5.8 days = 17 settlements). It only ever refuses more than evaluate_entry; ASSUMED_HOLD_DAYS (30), EWMA, funding thresholds, fees, borrow, basis budgets, sizing, risk limits and exits did not move. The engine, carry_backtest.simulate_settlements_series and cpp/carrycore.cpp make the same decision (tests/test_entry_gate_parity.py). IN-SAMPLE ONLY: DEMONSTRATED_HOLD_DAYS was measured by tools/carry_hold_audit.py on the same Bybit 4h corpus (2022-08-01..2026-09-09) this rule is then replayed on, so the replay improvement is not validation. Replay of that corpus, overlay/taker, 0% borrow: 77 -> 49 trades, net USD 29,889 -> 33,050; completed-trade median hold 9.7 days under the gate (5.8 before it); 52% of completed trades still lose money. tools/carry_oos_audit.py (chronological, NOT independent) is INCONCLUSIVE: 41 completed trades < 60. No holdout has been scored (HOLDOUT_SCORED is False). The only admissible evidence for this rule is FORWARD: settlements after the PR #124 merge (2026-10-25) observed by a book created under this rule's configuration fingerprint. carry_cost_gates_v1 and carry_overlay_v1 describe the previous entry rule and are marked superseded; their numbers are unchanged.

Declared 2026-10-27, BEFORE the first real-market observation was read, in tools/mainnet_public.py (MAINNET_PROTOCOL): how often would the production entry gate (carry_entry_gate_v1@BTCUSDT) have been open on Bybit's real mainnet public market, with an adequacy floor of 500 observations over 30 days and a 'rarely open' threshold of 5%. An opportunity count, not a P&L: no fills, fees paid, slippage or liquidation are modelled. Not yet evaluated. It adds one question and one trial; changing its thresholds, the gate, or the window after looking at the data is forbidden by the protocol, and a changed protocol needs a NEW entry here. Not a profit claim.
